beast.sight:woolback: Sheep. Horned, in a heavy coat, two to four together on the grass and in open wood. They are out by day and off the open ground by dusk. We live on the wild flocks.
beast.kill:woolback: Meat, fat and a hide. Nothing in it boils down. An ordinary animal of this ground and no feeder, so it pays no lees.
beast.habit:woolback: Grazes in herds of two to four on grass by day. Struck, it runs. None is left on the open grass after dusk.
beast.once:woolback: Beside the well of an empty village, one was grazing between the doors. The flocks walk right up to the old houses.
beast.sight:gobblet: A knee-high ground bird, brown with a pale head. It is about by day in the woods, on the open grass and on wet ground. We take it for meat and for feather.
beast.kill:gobblet: A little meat and a handful of feathers. There was no lees in it. It is a bird and no feeder.
beast.habit:gobblet: Out by day in woods, on grass and in wet country, two to four together. Struck, it runs.
beast.once:gobblet: Our first arrows, made at the workbench, were fletched with its feathers. Most arrows take them.
beast.sight:burrowhog: A boar, tusked and brown, rooting in the cold woods, on the crags and out on the snow. It is about by day. There is more meat on it than on anything else we hunt.
beast.kill:burrowhog: Meat in plenty and a thick hide. Nothing of it boiled down to lees.
beast.habit:burrowhog: Cold woods, crags and snow country, by day, one to three together. Struck, it runs. It is gone from the open by dusk.
beast.once:burrowhog: Rooting in the snow on Sānu at noon. Nothing else was out on the snow anywhere in sight. By day the boar has that country to itself.
beast.sight:dune_skipper: A hare the colour of the sand, long in the ear. It lives on the sand and the dry grass and is out by day. The sand people live on it.
beast.kill:dune_skipper: A hide and a little meat, and no lees. An ordinary animal, and hard to catch.
beast.habit:dune_skipper: Sand and dry grass, by day, in ones to threes. It is fast. Struck, it runs.
beast.once:dune_skipper: In daylight on Marudesha, while Maruhar still lived, the hares were the only thing moving. Nothing hostile came up on that sand by day.
beast.sight:glimmerfin: Bright fish, in the sea and the channels, at any hour. Nothing comes up in water, so they have it to themselves.
beast.kill:glimmerfin: Raw flesh and fine bones. It pays nothing. No feeder takes a body in water, so whatever swims is an ordinary animal.
beast.habit:glimmerfin: In shoals of two to five, in any open water, at any hour. The shoal keeps together.
beast.once:glimmerfin: A feeder that was after one of us came to the edge of the water and stopped there. The fish went on swimming round our legs.
beast.sight:gloomshade: Tama. Dark and upright, the height of a person. It is out every night, everywhere, and in the caves at any hour. It comes to anything dead that is left on land.
beast.kill:gloomshade: Bone, and a dark raw flesh that is the matter of other feeders it has eaten. One had a long bone in it of a kind no grazing animal here has.
beast.habit:gloomshade: Everywhere on the living ground at night, and in caves at any hour. A lamp does not turn one that is already up: it walks into the light. Full sun undoes it.
beast.once:gloomshade: At midday one came out of the brood nest in a Broken Store and fell apart at the wall in the sun. The nest puts them out by day as well.
beast.sight:thornling: Kantak. Bramble and sapling, waist-high, with a red bud on top. By day it stands among the bushes and you take it for one of them. At night it walks.
beast.kill:thornling: Thorn and plant fibre. It is bodied in the green growth it eats, and that growth is what came out of it.
beast.habit:thornling: By day it stands still among the bushes until a body comes within fourteen strides of it. After dark it walks.
beast.once:thornling: One went down at our walls in a Night raid. Since Vanahar was killed, its packs come for the stores at dusk.
beast.sight:gelcap: Kinva. A lump of jelly under a red skin, knee-high, sitting in the grass by day and hopping at anyone who comes near. Its jelly is what goes into the offering for Vanahar.
beast.kill:gelcap: Nothing under the skin but jelly: the rot out of fallen growth, which it formed in. There is no shape of its own inside.
beast.habit:gelcap: It sits on one patch until something disturbs it. Where it sat, the tall grass is gone when it moves.
beast.once:gelcap: Our first Vanahar Likeness took two lumps of its jelly. The likeness brings Vanahar up for what is in it.
beast.sight:bog_lurker: Kaddam. Chest-high, reed and peat with roots trailing. It lies in the mud of Panka sunk to the head, by day as well as night, and stands up when someone comes close.
beast.kill:bog_lurker: Reed fibre and peat, and the bones of whatever had died in the mud where it lay.
beast.habit:bog_lurker: On mud, with nothing near it, it lies sunk with only the head showing. It comes up in mud and never in open water.
beast.once:bog_lurker: In Panka one dropped a Lees Lump: lees that had set hard in the mud. It swallows the mud it lies in and whatever has set there.
beast.sight:frost_stalker: Vaka. A pale runner on four legs, out on the snow, in the pine woods and on the peaks at night, one to three together. It sees someone a long way off.
beast.kill:frost_stalker: Hide, and now and then a long tooth. It is bodied in the hide of what it has run down, and the hide is what came off it.
beast.habit:frost_stalker: Cold country, at night, in ones to threes. It sees a body from twenty-four strides and comes straight in.
beast.once:frost_stalker: At midday on the snow of Hima, one stood in full sun a little way off, unharmed. It must have taken its body on this ground's cold, under the sun.
beast.sight:cinder_wisp: Angār. A live coal hanging in the air. It comes up on the sand at night and throws embers. They said it hangs over the burning rock deep down at any hour.
beast.kill:cinder_wisp: When it went out, a little Ember Dust fell where it had hung. There was no body round the coal. The dust burns twice as long as coal does.
beast.habit:cinder_wisp: Hangs in the air and throws embers from ten strides, and comes no closer.
beast.once:cinder_wisp: Deep under the living ground, one hung beside molten rock in the middle of the day. The coal that comes up on the sand at night is down there at any hour.
beast.sight:stonegnawer: A low crawler on six legs, plated in scale the colour of stone. It is about under the ground at any hour, at nearly every depth.
beast.kill:stonegnawer: Plates of stone scale and lumps of coal. It feeds on rock, and on coal where it finds it, and its plates are scale of the stone it has eaten.
beast.habit:stonegnawer: The commonest thing under the ground, from just over the floor to just under the turf, at any hour. One or two together.
beast.once:stonegnawer: Killed beside the nest in a Sealed Store. Pieces of the dressed walls there are missing in clean gaps. This kind breeds in the stores and has been at the stone.
beast.sight:cave_skitter: Small, dark and eight-legged, quick on the rock, in caves at any hour. Its eyes show red in the dark. It comes in a pack.
beast.kill:cave_skitter: Fibre and nothing else: old cord, sacking, threads. It is bodied in whatever fibre it found.
beast.habit:cave_skitter: Small and fast, in packs of two to four, in caves at any hour.
beast.once:cave_skitter: One died on fungal turf on the living ground, and inside it was all white thread, the kind fungus puts through rock. Where nobody has worked, that is what it takes its body from.
beast.sight:crag_bat: Jatu. A dark bat. It hangs in the caves, and at night it flies over the crags and the peaks.
beast.kill:crag_bat: Feather and scraps of hide, from the birds and small animals it takes. It is bodied in them.
beast.habit:crag_bat: In caves at any hour, and in the air over the high rock of Pabbat and Sānu at night. One to three together.
beast.once:crag_bat: Over Pabbat at night, one came down out of the sky and died in the open. It is the same animal we meet in the caves. Below ground and in the high air it is one kind.
beast.sight:rustbound: Upright and tall as a big man, in rust-red plates over a grey frame. It stands in the rooms of the sealed stores and throws bolts of rust.
beast.kill:rustbound: Rust lumps, iron bars and barbed arrows. Opened over the pot, it had no bone anywhere in it.
beast.habit:rustbound: One that came from a nest goes no more than ten strides from it. It throws its rust from twelve strides.
beast.once:rustbound: A Barbed Arrow came out of one in a Sealed Store. It had eaten the harness and arrows stored there. The born say it was posted there.
beast.sight:sporeling: A lit fungus cap, knee-high, that hops. All through the hollow, at any hour, one to three together.
beast.kill:sporeling: Spore sacs, and sometimes the mushroom itself. It has no body of its own beyond the cap it forms in.
beast.habit:sporeling: Strike one, and every Kavak within sixteen strides comes for the one who struck it.
beast.once:sporeling: In the hollow one left a Glowing Mushroom where it died. That is the cap it had formed in, lying on the ground.
beast.sight:mycelid_knight: Fungus two strides tall, with a cap at the top, plates on its body and one limb grown out into an edge. In the hollow, at any hour.
beast.kill:mycelid_knight: Spore sacs, bone and Antar ore. The plates on it were Antar it had taken up from the rock.
beast.habit:mycelid_knight: Slow, two strides tall, and hard to knock back. Seldom more than two together.
beast.once:mycelid_knight: In a Vault of the hollow, one went down beside the nest. They breed where the lees was stored.
beast.sight:umbral_moth: A broad-winged dark flier, violet at the edges of the wings, in the air of the hollow at any hour. It throws its dust from a little way off.
beast.kill:umbral_moth: Moth Dust, and almost nothing under it. It is bodied in the dust that falls from the great caps.
beast.habit:umbral_moth: Never lands. It throws dust from nine strides.
beast.once:umbral_moth: At the Jīmūt Altar the kite went up with its dust tied on. The great flier of the high air is reached through the remains of this small one.
beast.sight:glowmaw: A long-jawed runner on four legs, lit along the back and the tail, in the hollow at any hour. It is fast.
beast.kill:glowmaw: Hide and spore sacs. It eats the hopping caps, and the light along its back is what it has eaten.
beast.habit:glowmaw: A fast runner, lit along the back. One or two together, in the hollow at any hour.
beast.once:glowmaw: One dropped a lump of Tala ore in the hollow. A feeder drops what it ate, so something it ate had been in the lower rock.
beast.sight:rift_ray: Broad, blue and scaled, with a long tail, in the air over the islands. The same make of flier as the bat and the moth, filled with other matter.
beast.kill:rift_ray: Vihanga Scale. It feeds on the undersides of the pale sheets that hang under the islands and on what falls from the rims.
beast.habit:rift_ray: In the air over the islands at any hour, one or two together. It stoops on a body from above.
beast.once:rift_ray: On the islands one came at us from under the rim, far below where we stood. It rides under the rim and rises over it.
beast.sight:shardling: Splintered pale crystal, a person's height and twice as broad, on the surface of the islands. It stands like one of the spires round it.
beast.kill:shardling: Shards, and now and then Patik ore. The shards still cut, and they loosen whatever holds them.
beast.habit:shardling: Until it has someone to go for, it does not move. Slow, and very hard.
beast.once:shardling: On the islands one dropped a piece of Patik ore. The crystal kinds feed on the seams of that ore and carry bits of it in their bodies.
beast.sight:aether_wisp: A bright crystal moving through the air over the islands by itself. The air round it shimmers as over a hot stone. It throws pieces of crystal.
beast.kill:aether_wisp: Crystal fell where it had hung, and the air round it stopped shimmering. There was nothing else.
beast.habit:aether_wisp: A bright crystal in the air, one to three together. It throws from twelve strides.
beast.once:aether_wisp: A Vihanga Scale fell from one on the islands. It had been feeding on a dead Vihanga.
beast.sight:moonspawn: Chandasāvak. Taller than a Tama, dark, with a pale violet light of its own. On the dark night the moon is hollow, and these are what come down out of it.
beast.kill:moonspawn: Shade Flesh from what it had eaten, and Moon Slivers, which are bits of its own body: lees set hard and pale. The born say the slivers are pieces of the moon.
beast.habit:moonspawn: Never goes down before dawn. The sun undoes every one still standing.
beast.once:moonspawn: At sunrise one stood in the open and came apart. It seems its kind has never had to go down before a dawn.
beast.sight:lunar_howler: Ulūk. A dark flier with pale wings that comes on the dark night and no other. Nothing in the air is quicker. It comes down out of the moon with the rest.
beast.kill:lunar_howler: Moon Slivers and little else. It is bodied in the same pale set lees as the walkers of the dark night.
beast.habit:lunar_howler: In the air on the dark night only. The fastest thing we have met.
beast.once:lunar_howler: Dawn found one still in the air, and the sun took it apart. It is of the same deep kind as the walkers and bears no light.
beast.sight:sproutling: Small green walkers of sprout and sapling, knee-high. They come up round the stone once Vanahar is half spent.
beast.kill:sproutling: Nothing. They had fed on nothing yet, and the pot got nothing from them.
beast.habit:sproutling: When their strongest goes back down, they go with it.
beast.once:sproutling: At the Vanahar Altar the animal went back down with Paroha still on the floor. They went with it.
beast.sight:dune_mite: Plated crawlers of grit on six legs, the colour of sand. They come off Maruhar's body when it thrashes.
beast.kill:dune_mite: Empty grit. They live between the burrower's plates and had eaten nothing of their own, so there was no lees.
beast.habit:dune_mite: Shed from the burrower when it thrashes. They leave nothing behind.
beast.once:dune_mite: At the Maruhar Altar the burrower went back under with Kīta still on the sand, and they went with it.
beast.sight:ashen_raider: Shūra. Sand people who march with a blade, grey with the ash of their own fires. They come at first light for what the peopls store, and go home at dusk.
beast.kill:ashen_raider: He carried a Mūda, a grey token broken from fired sand, and now and then an iron bar. The lees on him had been taken on the way, for the fire.
beast.habit:ashen_raider: A fighter with a blade. He comes with the Sand March at dawn and goes home at dusk.
beast.once:ashen_raider: One fell at our walls during a Night raid. A few of his people now come in behind the dusk packs, to reach a store while the pack has us busy.
beast.sight:ashen_hexer: Dāhaga. A sand man with a long iron, its head a basket of pitch. His people burn a kill where it lies with that iron, and he throws its burning pitch.
beast.kill:ashen_hexer: He carried Mūda, and the long iron with its basket head packed with pitch and Ember Dust.
beast.habit:ashen_hexer: He stands off and throws burning pitch from thirteen strides. He does not close.
beast.once:ashen_hexer: Among what one carried was a Crystal from one of our stores. A march takes what it finds for the fire, and crystal is lees to them.
beast.sight:siege_brute: Bedaga. The biggest of the sand people's marchers, in thick padding, with a beam for doors and chests. He comes late in a march.
beast.kill:siege_brute: He carried more Mūda than the rest of the march, and iron.
beast.habit:siege_brute: The biggest of the march. Slow, and hard to knock back.
beast.once:siege_brute: During a Sand March at our houses he came up only once the fighting was half done. He comes late.
beast.sight:m_thornling: It formed on the Iron Totem as the food on the bones was opened under the hand: a small green lump with a thorn.
beast.kill:m_thornling: When it took down a feeder, it struck as hard as iron. Its body is the iron of the totem head.
beast.habit:m_thornling: Stays beside whoever carries the bones it feeds on, and goes for other feeders, which are food to it.
beast.once:m_thornling: One of us went down at night with it out, and it was gone from the ground in the same moment. Nothing was driving the totem any more.
beast.sight:m_wisp: A point of colour the shade of Hīrak, which formed on the Hīrak Totem once its bones were opened. There is no shape to it beyond the point.
beast.kill:m_wisp: What struck the feeder down was gem. It took its body from the Hīrak of the totem head and is as hard as that.
beast.habit:m_wisp: Close to the bearer, on sufferance, as a weaker feeder stays near a stronger. The feeders round it are what it goes for.
beast.once:m_wisp: In a cave under the living ground its bearer went down, and the point of colour was gone with no trace left.
beast.sight:m_brazier: An ember in the air beside the Jalit Totem. It formed on the Shade Flesh bound to the carved bones and took its body from the Jalit head.
beast.kill:m_brazier: A feeder fell to it at the edge of the lamplight. It strikes as hard as Jalit, and nobody boils one of these for its remains.
beast.habit:m_brazier: Hangs near the hand that carries its food and goes for any feeder near it. Feeders are what it eats.
beast.once:m_brazier: On the sand at night the one carrying the Jalit Totem fell, and the ember went out with the fall.
beast.sight:m_shade: Off the Antar Totem, a small dark flier. The food on the bones is Shade Flesh, and the body it took is the Antar of the head.
beast.kill:m_shade: In the hollow it took down a feeder, which is food to it. There was nothing of itself to open.
beast.habit:m_shade: Its bearer drove the totem once, as the food was opened, and it takes that hand for a stronger animal whose food this is. It flies close and goes for feeders.
beast.once:m_shade: Its bearer went down under a pack in the hollow, and the flier was gone at once. Nothing binds it to anyone.
beast.sight:m_mycelid: A small lit fungus cap formed on the Tala Totem. Its look follows the metal in the head, as every one of these does.
beast.kill:m_mycelid: Its blows are as hard as Tala, and a feeder went down under them. There is nothing in it but that metal.
beast.habit:m_mycelid: One stays under a hand at a time. A Whistle or a worn piece lets a hand have a second. It goes for feeders.
beast.once:m_mycelid: When its bearer fell on the lower floors of the hollow, the little cap was gone at once.
beast.sight:m_zephyr: A small white flier, off the Ākās Totem. Under its look it is the same kind of animal as all the others that form on a totem.
beast.kill:m_zephyr: Over the islands it brought down a feeder. It strikes as hard as Ākās, and it leaves no remains of its own.
beast.habit:m_zephyr: Goes where the carried food goes, and turns on other feeders when they come near.
beast.once:m_zephyr: On the islands one of us fell with the flier out, and it went in the same moment.
beast.sight:m_shardling: A lit splinter, like a small one of the island kind, off the Patik Totem. It formed on the raw remains bound to the bones.
beast.kill:m_shardling: Hard as the Patik it took its body from, it killed a feeder and left nothing of its own.
beast.habit:m_shardling: By the hand that carries its food, on sufferance. Any feeder round it is food, and it goes for them.
beast.once:m_shardling: Among the spires its bearer went down, and the splinter was gone at the same moment. No hand was driving it after that.
beast.sight:m_moon: A dark four-legged thing a hand high, with pale tines, off the Gahan Totem. No closer cause for that look is known than the metal.
beast.kill:m_moon: It ran a feeder down and killed it. Gahan is the hardest metal there is, and this is as hard. Nothing of it is left for a pot.
beast.habit:m_moon: Runs at the bearer's heel and goes for any feeder in reach. The food it stays for is the Shade Flesh on the bones.
beast.once:m_moon: On the dark night its bearer fell at our walls, and the little tined thing was gone with the fall.
beast.sight:m_cairn: A point of yellow light, off the Cairn Lamp. The head of that totem is a lamp from the housing of an eighth stone, and the look follows it.
beast.kill:m_cairn: A feeder went down to it. It strikes as hard as the lamp it took its body from, and there is nothing in it to open.
beast.habit:m_cairn: Like the other eight looks, it stays by the hand that carries the bones and goes for feeders.
beast.once:m_cairn: Beside a cairn its bearer went down, and the yellow point was gone in the same breath.
eight.sight:b_colossus: Roots came up through the joints of the paving, and then the body: root, bark and moss, far larger than anything else in the wood. Its roots ran up the six oaks of the floor.
eight.kill:b_colossus: Root and wood all through, and iron bars from hunters who failed here. The Vanahar Remains still move. They loosen made things, so a bench built round them joins two pieces into one.
eight.loss:b_colossus: From the next dusk, packs came for our stores: Tama and Kantak together, in twos and threes, until dawn. Everything we met hit harder and took more killing than before.
eight.habit:b_colossus: Another answered the next likeness, as large as the first: the strongest of the next wood over, moved onto the empty ground. It slams the ground round itself, charges, and throws up roots when hurt.
eight.once:b_colossus: One of us stood behind an oak of the floor. It charged straight at the trunk, and the oak stood. Its roots run up those trees.
eight.said:b_colossus: The forebears set Vanahar over Vana when the stones were raised. Lees from it turns everything of the woods that walks, and that country comes back to us.
eight.intro:b_colossus: Roots push up between the paving stones.
eight.phase:b_colossus.1: It tears its roots up out of the paving.
eight.sight:b_maw: The sand in the bowl moved, and a long body of segments came up under one of us. It is bodied in grit and throws grit in fans. The only footing was the rim and the gilded platform.
eight.kill:b_maw: Grit through the length of it, and at the middle a mass of rock from beside the molten rock. Gold from the lures was in it. Woken by fire in a ring of Deep Rock, its remains loosen Jalit ore.
eight.loss:b_maw: At dawn the sand-country people marched on our houses, grey with ash, and went home at dusk. Since the kill the sand of Marudesha has had other kinds on it at night.
eight.habit:b_maw: The next lure brought up another through the sand, as large: the strongest of the next sand over. It travels under whoever stands on the sand, comes up beneath them, and throws grit.
eight.once:b_maw: Kīta were on the floor of the bowl before Maruhar came up. They ran to the place where it would surface and were there first.
eight.said:b_maw: Maruhar was set over the waste, and the sand people lived under it. Its remains burn hot enough to melt Jalit ore.
eight.intro:b_maw: The sand in the bowl begins to move.
eight.phase:b_maw.1: Up out of the sand, it thrashes, and grit pours off it.
eight.sight:b_warden: A pale upright body came up over the stone when the bell was set down, and it hung in the air. It threw slow pale lumps in fans and was somewhere else between throws.
eight.kill:b_warden: Pale set matter with Hīrak through it, and lumps of Hīrak. The Kankāl Remains hold a relation to the hollow. Set round with Black Glass, they make the gate to it.
eight.loss:b_warden: On the dark night after the kill, the deep kind came up over the whole country and the sky went violet. At dawn the sun took apart every one still standing.
eight.habit:b_warden: A third came to the bell, as large as the others. It hangs, throws pale lumps in fans, rings and spirals, and changes place. Near the end, Tama come in for it.
eight.once:b_warden: We killed it while the Tama it had drawn were still on the floor. They had come to eat it as it failed, and we were in the way.
eight.said:b_warden: Kankāl was set in the deep rock by the forebears to hold the dark night shut. The peopls broke that seal, and now the moon's young come down.
eight.intro:b_warden: The bell is rung, and something pale comes up over the stone.
eight.phase:b_warden.1: Turning in place, it throws pale lumps out in spirals.
eight.phase:b_warden.2: Its body begins to come apart. Tama close in on it.
eight.sight:b_sporemother: The smoke reached the roof, and the roof moved: a mass of cap and thread hanging from the dome by its own growth. Pieces of cap fell from it, and Kavak formed where they landed.
eight.kill:b_sporemother: Cap and thread, Antar bars from the smokers it had eaten, and the Guhamāt Remains. Bedded in Hollow Rock over a fire, they loosen Tala and Ākās ore, and the ore never gets hot.
eight.loss:b_sporemother: Everything we met hit harder and took more killing from the eighth night after. Its host had stayed round it for the cap it dropped. With nothing falling, its packs will go where food is, so it seems.
eight.habit:b_sporemother: Smoke from a third smoker brought another down off the same roof, as large. It drops cap on marked ground, and Kavak form where the pieces land. Near the end it tears loose and swings.
eight.once:b_sporemother: A Kavak formed on the floor where a piece of its falling cap had landed. The pieces are raw remains, and the lowest feeders form on them.
eight.said:b_sporemother: The telling puts Guhamāt in the Under, a mother with its small ones round it. The smoker is burned at its altar to bring it down off the roof.
eight.intro:b_sporemother: Smoke reaches the roof of the dome, and the roof moves.
eight.phase:b_sporemother.1: Its cap splits open, and the inside glows.
eight.phase:b_sporemother.2: Most of its growth tears from the roof, and it swings on the rest.
eight.sight:b_regent: Something pale and very large came down out of the high air over the kite and circled the floor without landing. It stooped on one of us at a time and threw bolts from its body.
eight.kill:b_regent: Pale stuff that weighs almost nothing, and Tala bars. A Jīmūt Remains stands up from the hand however it is held. Set in a frame of Tala bars, it makes the gate to the islands.
eight.loss:b_regent: By the eighth night Jatu were in the air over every country we walked, where before they stayed in the caves and over the crags. Everything we met hit harder.
eight.habit:b_regent: Over the third kite came another, as large as the first. It circles out of reach and stoops, throws bolts in fans and rings, and pieces of it fall on marked ground.
eight.once:b_regent: A Jīmūt Remains from an earlier kill was in one of our hands when the kite went up. It stood straight up from the hand. We take that to point at the islands overhead.
eight.said:b_regent: Jīmūt is the storm the forebears set over the open air, and no hearth's edge has ever stopped it. Fly the kite from its altar and it comes down.
eight.intro:b_regent: Something pale and large circles down over the kite.
eight.phase:b_regent.1: Pieces of its body start to fall on the floor.
eight.phase:b_regent.2: A scream, and it stoops lower over the floor.
eight.sight:b_luminarch: Crystal gathered over the stone and turned. In the middle hung a body of dense crystal with a ring of pieces turning round it, and its beam swung slowly after one of us.
eight.kill:b_luminarch: Dense crystal all through, with Ākās bars in it. Bedded in Island Rock over a fire, the Ratan Remains loosen Patik ore. Its Ratan Crystal is the best seat a cut line can run to.
eight.loss:b_luminarch: Everything hit harder and took more killing from the eighth night, as after every first kill. Its kinds had stayed on the islands round it. Now their packs have nothing to stay for, which would bring them to our gate.
eight.habit:b_luminarch: The third lens brought one as large as the first. It throws rays and a slow beam, as a staff throws with no hand to tire, and it changes place. Near the end Sakal form on the pieces that come off it.
eight.once:b_luminarch: At its last change a Sakal formed on the floor where a piece of its body had fallen. The kind forms on its own loose remains.
eight.said:b_luminarch: Nobody of ours has seen Ratan. They said it is a jewel the forebears set far off, that the lens gathers the light, and that the light calls it up.
eight.intro:b_luminarch: Crystal gathers over the stone and begins to turn.
eight.phase:b_luminarch.1: The ring of crystal round it begins to turn.
eight.phase:b_luminarch.2: Pieces come away as it stops holding its shape.
eight.sight:b_hart: Hoofbeats out of the dark, then a body on four legs with tines, giving a pale violet light. It ran straight at one of us and slammed the ground. Chandasāvak came up behind it.
eight.kill:b_hart: Lees set hard and pale, and Patik bars. Bedded in Black Glass over a fire, the Kuranga Remains loosen Gahan ore, the ore that lies on the floor. They give its kind's violet light.
eight.loss:b_hart: A round of the moon later, the dark night came with the deep kind in packs and nothing at their head. Everything we met hit harder and took more killing.
eight.habit:b_hart: Every mask has brought one as large as the first, at night. It charges, slams a wide ring of ground, throws blades of its own body, and from halfway on it is in one place and then another.
eight.once:b_hart: Our fight with it ran until dawn. When the sun came up it went back down. The sun undoes its kind.
eight.said:b_hart: On the dark night the moon is hollow, and Kuranga is the largest thing that comes down out of it. Wear the mask before its altar and it sees you.
eight.intro:b_hart: Hoofbeats come out of the dark toward the stone.
eight.phase:b_hart.1: Violet light runs along its tines.
eight.phase:b_hart.2: It charges, and then it is somewhere else on the floor.
eight.sight:b_sovereign: Stone moved inside the cairn, and a stack of dressed stone rose out of the base and hung there, standing stones on top. It threw glowing stones and swept a beam across the floor.
eight.kill:b_sovereign: Dressed stone, the gems and lamps of the housing it had eaten, Gahan bars, and arms better than any other store holds. The Nihān Remains are the strongest raw remains anyone carries.
eight.loss:b_sovereign: Silahādak came up on the surface at night and came in with the dusk packs. The base under every cairn we passed stood broken, and everything hit harder again.
eight.habit:b_sovereign: Each key has brought one up through the base, as large as the first. It throws glowing stones in fans and rings, swings a beam, and changes place. Near the end the deep kind falls in behind it.
eight.once:b_sovereign: After the kill, one of us stood on the base. Under the paving it is hollow, with clean gaps where the animal ate its way through.
eight.said:b_sovereign: When the great lees ran out, the forebears closed their first stone under the cairn, to save it for the day it could be lit. Nihān is the store they left.
eight.intro:b_sovereign: Stone grinds and shifts inside the cairn.
eight.phase:b_sovereign.1: The stack of stone parts, and its glowing middle shows.
eight.phase:b_sovereign.2: Everything it has eaten shows as it comes apart.
eight.line:altar_waits: Nothing lies on the stone. It takes {a} {item}.
eight.line:dawn_down: {name} goes back down as the sun comes up.
eight.line:fallen.sub: What was in it lies on the floor
eight.line:night_only: Kuranga comes up here only after dark.
eight.line:withdraws: {name} goes back the way it came.
